headline: Hyperscalers charge double or more over neoclouds across all six GPUs; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: H100 SXM shows the widest hyperscaler premium at +217%, with a hyperscaler median of $12.12 versus $3.82 at neoclouds.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour, with a market index of $2.39 and a marketplace median of just $0.50 across 3 providers.
B200 sets the top of the market with a $6.84 index and a hyperscaler median of $14.24, yet its $3.04 per PFLOP-hour beats H200 at $5.13.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for B200 ($5.98), H200 ($3.59), H100 SXM ($2.69) and MI300X ($0.50), while Vast.ai leads on A100 80GB SXM ($1.19) and L40S ($0.73).
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $7.02 per PFLOP-hour despite a modest $2.19 market index.
watch: With only 6 days of history, watch whether the first 7-day change readings confirm or narrow the wide hyperscaler premiums on H100 SXM (+217%) and MI300X (+214%).
